method.variability: Initial D3D12 first-frame pair 9,941/7,445 ms and initial after warm median 38.91 ms/p95 118.70 ms. Later before/after warm medians 12.38/12.57 ms. No sample discarded from first-frame medians; no driver reset or cache flush.
method.scope: Initial full BGFX-build CTest suite followed by 49 original-fixture reruns with required GPU/reference flags; statuses consolidated by test name, with initial failures preserved. Eight selected wgpu/Vulkan fixtures. wgpu/OpenGL phase/image control is 10,000, not a repeated 40,000 benchmark. Known wgpu/D3D12 large-scene bind-group failure remains. Traditional Coin/OpenGL control uses its separate SoGLRenderAction path.
